description: This file declares the GstDispatcherThread class and its factory, which are responsible for handling GStreamer bus messages in a dedicated thread within the Rialto media server component. It defines interfaces, private members, and threading mechanisms for GStreamer event dispatching.

classes.name: GstDispatcherThreadFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating GstDispatcherThread instances, implementing IGstDispatcherThreadFactory.

classes.name: GstDispatcherThread
classes.description: Implements IGstDispatcherThread, manages a thread for handling GStreamer bus messages, and interacts with a client and GStreamer pipeline.

methods.name: createGstDispatcherThread
methods.description: Creates and returns a new GstDispatcherThread instance.

methods.name: GstDispatcherThread
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dispatcher thread with client, pipeline, and GStreamer wrapper.

methods.name: ~GstDispatcherThread
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up the dispatcher thread.

methods.name: gstBusEventHandler
methods.description: Handles GStreamer bus messages for the associated pipeline.
